The '''1969–70 Serie A''' season was won by [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]].

==Teams==
[[SS Lazio|Lazio]], [[Brescia Calcio|Brescia]] and [[AS Bari|Bari]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
